body.name: All-branch Gaussian-multiplier confidence set
body.construction: Let \(\mathbb G_n^*=n^{-1/2}\sum_{i=1}^n\xi_i(X_i-\widehat z)\) and \(E_n=\{\min_j\widehat z_j\geq\eta^4/2\}\). On \(E_n\), let \(c_n\) be the conditional \((1-\alpha)\)-quantile of \(\max_{s\in\{-,+\},\,\beta\in\{0,1\}^6}|\nabla\widetilde f_\beta^s(\widehat z)^\top\mathbb G_n^*|\), put \(w_n=c_n/\sqrt n+n^{-3/4}\), and set \(\mathcal C_n=[\max\{0,\widetilde F_-(\widehat z)-w_n\},\min\{1,\widetilde F_+(\widehat z)+w_n\}]\). On \(E_n^c\), set \(c_n=w_n=0\) and \(\mathcal C_n=[0,1]\).
